cases.name: Shala Mariche Smith
cases.about:
She was an employee at Larned Correctional Mental Health Facility. On Monday, the facility posted a tribute to her on its Facebook page saying, every member was heartbroken to learn about the death of Shala and Carver.

“Shala embraced her role as a case manager and had the upmost respect from both employees and residents. Her upbeat attitude was infectious and her smile could light up a room. She never backed down from a task and was always on hand to help and support her friends and coworkers,” said the correctional facility.

Her Go Fund Me said, "Shala was a loving mother, grandmother, aunt, daughter, sister and friend. She was always someone you could count on and she loved her family more than anything."
cases.narrative: The investigation determined that just after 3 a.m. on Saturday, Jan. 8, Jon Smith arrived in a pickup truck at Shala Smith’s residence at 524 Park St. in Larned. He entered the house alone, while carrying a shotgun. Evidence indicates that he shot and killed both Shala Smith, his wife although separated, and Carver Smith, his 12-year-old son. He then shot himself.
